what_works: Generous white space and consistent 2‑6 px spacing create a clear, uncluttered layout
Primary orange accent highlights call‑to‑action buttons, drawing focus without overwhelming the design
Strong visual hierarchy with a large headline and smaller supporting text establishes immediate context
Simple icon‑plus‑label cards for tools provide quick visual recognition and easy navigation
Flat, border‑less button style with rounded corners (4 px radius) reinforces a modern, cohesive aesthetic
